verdict.rationale: Kitty documents and hands-on-verifies a scripts/remote-control interface (kitten @ commands) and supports launching in `--detach` mode with a listening socket, which enables automation-style control loops (open, send-text, read-text, close) as verified in the runtime probe. However, kitty is fundamentally a GUI terminal emulator; there is no documentation of a true headless/no-display mode for CI pipelines (e.g., Xvfb-free operation) or CI-specific guidance. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless-without-display documentation, and independent confirmation of running in a CI pipeline environment.
